title: Commit code changes with a clear message
trigger_text: commit staged or unstaged code changes to version control with a well-formed commit message
preconditions: the working tree has changes worth committing

body.instruction: Show what changed so the message reflects the actual diff, not an assumption
Stage the files that belong in this commit; leave unrelated changes out
Write a concise message: a short imperative summary line, then a body explaining why if it isn't obvious

done_criteria: a single focused commit exists with a message that would make sense to a reviewer months later
notes: Do not bundle unrelated changes into one commit.
Do not invent a message before looking at the diff.
